lines.text: And the forecast only gets wilder.
It's a gas giant, about sixty-three light-years away. And it's deep cobalt blue.
lines.caption: It's a gas giant, about 63 light-years away. And it's deep cobalt blue.

lines.text: Scientists think its clouds hold silicate particles that form tiny drops of glass.
The air up there is hotter than one thousand degrees Celsius.
lines.caption: The air up there is hotter than 1,000 °C.

lines.text: And the winds howl at over seven thousand kilometers per hour.
lines.caption: And the winds howl at over 7,000 km/h.

lines.text: So that glass rain doesn't fall down. It flies sideways.
